Scene: A welcoming survivor railway depot inside a vast old brick industrial hall at blue hour. Left-middle: a scarred equipment workbench with a large iron hammer, short induction staff and coat on a rack. Middle-back: a small warm desk where a blacksmith would work, a hanging amber work lamp above and an unlit rectangular projection wall. Center foreground: open worn stone floor with rail tracks. Right-middle: tall arched open exit leading to foggy blue freight tracks and a waiting small rail cart. Far left and right framing: shelves, pipes, hanging chains. Small potted plants and amber fire give this home a human, hopeful mood. The room must feel enormous and immersive, no people. Workbench at x28 y60%, lamp and desk x49 y48%, exit arch x79 y45%.

Scene: A sprawling mechanical scrap yard inside a ruined industrial courtyard. Massive heaps of iron wheels, boilers and gears form dramatic silhouettes on both sides; a clear central path recedes into cool mist. Foreground-right a small glowing cyan sealed relay box on a rusty table. Middle-left a recognizable tiny brass repair robot caught in a large vise among broken machines. Left-front disassembled salvage engine. Middle-right a small supply pile. Back-center a tall derelict loading machine and space for a hostile automaton. Three background paths and one left foreground return passage, distant factory chimneys, warm amber worklights, extraordinary tactile detail.

Scene: Inside a silent deserted vintage industrial passenger and freight train at night. Wide cinematic interior view looking diagonally down the carriage, old dark green leather benches and aged brass poles, arched windows revealing misty foundry lights. Center-left seat holds a tied kraft paper resident parcel with cloth visible, no written label. Right-middle a small opened mechanic's toolbox with copper cable coil; beside it a sealed supply canister. Rear-center passage to an open carriage doorway and blue-lit platform. Amber reading lights, weathered timber floor, haunting but gentle atmosphere, no passengers, detailed cozy abandoned railway scene.
